text: Learning that student assistants are wanted for the upcoming International Academic Symposium, I am writing to apply for this position with enthusiasm.
As a senior majoring in Literature, I find myself well qualified for the role.
First, I am fluent in both spoken and written English, which enables me to communicate smoothly with foreign scholars.
Moreover, having served as an assistant at campus forums, I possess sound teamwork and organizational skills.
Not only can I manage daily tasks reliably, but I also handle unexpected changes with calm.
My resume is attached below for your review.
I would deeply appreciate an interview at your convenience.
